observation.causal_attribution: The command's failure text identified a branch-or-revision mismatch. Source inspection at the pre-change commit showed cmd_claims copied the selected branch when --branch was omitted; the later reconcile and successful registered-worktree claim establish the recovery sequence, not recurrence.
observation.environmental_pressure: The claim CLI materialized a cached branch from the session snapshot before Session.acquire_claim performed its live checkout refresh. The stale exact-scope precondition prevented the refresh from completing the intended branch-drift workflow.

pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Leave branch unspecified when the caller omitted --branch. Let claim acquisition refresh and verify the exact registered checkout, then derive its current branch. Continue treating an explicit --branch as an exact live precondition.
pressure_hypothesis.basis: A real claim attempt after a registered checkout branch change failed with working-checkout-unavailable because the CLI had included an entry-time branch in the exact worktree scope.
